segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so quick check on the Northstar renewal. They're at 84 seats today, adding 26 for the support org, target go-live is March 3.

segments.text: Okay, 110 total. Did they accept the two-year term or are they still pushing for annual?
